everyone.title: Settings from the chat
everyone.text: Ask an agent where a setting is. Its card changes yours right there, and the agent never sees the value. A manager turns the tool on per agent.

everyone.title: Cards with buttons
everyone.text: An agent can offer you a choice as buttons in the chat. A button does one thing with your own permissions, and nothing happens until you press it.

everyone.title: The iOS app
everyone.text: OtoDock is on TestFlight for iPhone and iPad. One app reaches more than one OtoDock, with dictation, notifications and alarms with sound.

everyone.title: Your subscription on every agent
everyone.text: Your own AI subscription now works on every agent that allows its engine. A new chat opens on the engine you use most there.

everyone.title: Documents, checked as they go
everyone.text: Agents check the Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files they make before you get them. Word gets tracked changes, slides themes, sheets their formula values.

everyone.title: Chat windows and the company map
everyone.text: A terminal chat's windows fold into icons you can reorder, and the chat remembers them. The company map opens on the agent you came from.

admins.title: Read the upgrade notes first
admins.text: Macs paired before 1.9.1 pair again. DSA keys and Python 3.11 stop working. Two models swap, engine limits lift, dictation may bill. Each note says what to do.

admins.title: A department in one step
admins.text: Install a whole department from the community. Its agents, shared library and paused schedules arrive together.

admins.title: Sign-in addresses follow their tools
admins.text: Each MCP adds the sign-in addresses it needs and takes over a matching row of yours. A new address waits under Admin, MCP Servers until you allow it.

admins.title: Reconnect needed, with the reason
admins.text: An account's card under User Settings, Integrations says Reconnect needed and why: the vendor removed OtoDock or refuses its access. Open it, press Reconnect.

admins.title: Who sees an agent's own tasks
admins.text: Only editors and managers now see an agent's own tasks, triggers and runs, in apps too. Who is told on a shared task picks who hears of its runs.

admins.title: Platform only, for voice
admins.text: The chat audio policy gains Platform only: all voice and dictation go through your speech provider, which bills it. Safari and iPhone dictation do too.

everyone.title: A new look
everyone.text: A new logo, font and dark theme, with clearer colours and plainer words.

everyone.title: The Android app
everyone.text: Agents send notifications and alarms straight to your phone, and can see where you are when you allow it. It comes to Google Play after this release.

everyone.title: Choose where a chat runs
everyone.text: A new remote machines icon on the chat page shows where the chat runs. Tap it to pick or change the place.

everyone.title: Auto, the default mode
everyone.text: Auto is now the default permission mode for every chat.

admins.title: An admin command line
admins.text: Admins can run the otodock-admin.sh script to reset a password, turn off a lost authenticator or print support information.

admins.title: Report a reply
admins.text: People can flag an agent's reply. You read the reports under Admin, Reports.

admins.title: GitHub through a GitHub App
admins.text: GitHub now signs in through a GitHub App, OtoDock's hosted one by default. An admin can add their own under Admin, MCP Servers.

everyone.title: Transfer a call to a colleague
everyone.text: The agent can hand a caller over to a colleague on the route's list.

everyone.title: Automatic language detection
everyone.text: Calls and dictation find the language from the first words and answer in it.

everyone.title: Upload a whole folder
everyone.text: Drop a folder into the chat or the workspace. Every file in it uploads.

everyone.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
everyone.text: The fastest Claude model, now on Claude Code and Direct LLM.

everyone.title: Call you from the chat
everyone.text: An agent that finds something in your chat can call you about it, knowing everything in that chat.

admins.title: Back up and restore by script
admins.text: One script backs up the whole install. Another one restores it.

admins.title: See the version and new releases
admins.text: Setup shows the running version and tells you when a new release is out.

admins.title: Ask for a PIN on outbound calls
admins.text: A route can ask the person who answers for a PIN before the agent speaks.
